title: ✨ WALK WITH THE ONE WHO IS ✨
paragraphs:
✨ WALK WITH THE ONE WHO IS ✨
“I don’t wait on perfect timing — I walk with the One who is.”

When you move in faith, every step becomes the right time.
#FaithInMotion #WalkWithHim #PurposeDrivenLife

📖 Verse: “But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength;
they will soar on wings like eagles,
they will run and not grow weary,
they will walk and not be faint.” — Isaiah 40 : 31 (NIV)
Stop waiting for the perfect moment — the moment becomes perfect when you walk with Him.
